title: CarPlay Is Additive
summary: Casey Liss argues that CarPlay should be viewed as an additive technology that enhances the car ownership experience rather than a replacement for native car systems. The article addresses critics who view smartphone integration as problematic, defending the value that CarPlay and similar technologies bring to driving.
problem_solved: Addresses the misconception that CarPlay is a replacement technology for car infotainment systems rather than an additive enhancement.
why_valuable: Provides a nuanced perspective on the relationship between native car software and smartphone integration, helping readers understand why these technologies coexist rather than compete.
